default_in_repayment.text: Based on our audit procedures and the information and explanations provided by the management, we are of the opinion that the company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender.

fraud.text:
We have been informed that one of the DP clients of the Company has raised a concern regarding a fraudulent off market transfer of shares from his demat account. The Company has filed an FIR with the police in this connection and the investigations are in progress Pending outcome of the same, the Company has disclosed the disputed amount of Rs. 130 millions as a Contingent Liability in the books of account. 
Based on the above alleged fraudulent transfer, for which investigations is on, we have filed Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, based on the above alleged fraud reported by the Company as detailed in Note no. 38(ii)(c) of the standalone financial statements.
